title.narrative: Contribute towards achieving the targets of National Strategic Plan aligned with End TB Strategy for reducing the burden of TB and MDR-TB in Pakistan. - Pakistan (01-Jul-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Pakistan, Tuberculosis, Mercy Corps (MC)This program has the following goals: To reduce TB mortality rate by 40% by 2023 compared to 2015. To reduce estimated TB incidence by at least 4% in 2023 compared to 2015. The objectives of this program are: To detect and notify at least 1,300,000 cases of new TB episode during the years 2021 to 2023. To maintain the annual treatment success rate at 90% and over during the years 2021 to 2023. To enroll in treatment with 2nd line TB medicines 21,000 cases of MDR/RR-TB cases during the years 2021 to 2023. To ensure the provision of preventive TB therapy to at least 650,000 eligible people during the years 2021 to 2023
